claims.claim: B is dining at a restaurant with A
claims.attribute: B is sharing a restaurant meal with A

evidence.quote: here comes our waitress with our check
what a nice dinner that was

claims.adjudication_reason: 'our waitress' and 'our check' in turn 3 directly presuppose B is dining at a restaurant with A; turn 11 confirms they had dinner together.

claims.claim: B proposed or suggested a 20% tip
claims.attribute: B stated that 20% would be an appropriate tip amount

evidence.quote: I agree that 20 % would be just about right

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'I agree that 20%' presupposes B proposed or suggested the 20% figure; agreement requires a prior proposal by the other party.

claims.claim: B commented that the service was good
claims.attribute: B expressed a positive opinion about the restaurant service

evidence.quote: Yes , the service was quite good .

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'Yes, the service was quite good' with the affirmative 'Yes' plus full restatement presupposes B made a prior comment about the service being good.

claims.claim: B commented that the dinner was nice
claims.attribute: B expressed a positive opinion about the dinner

evidence.quote: Yes , what a nice dinner that was !

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'Yes, what a nice dinner that was!' presupposes B made a prior comment expressing the dinner was nice; the 'Yes' signals agreement with B's statement.

claims.claim: B was offered dessert by A during the meal
claims.attribute: B was asked if they wanted dessert
claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 1 'Do you want some dessert?' is A's explicit offer directed to B; this is a direct speech act with no inference needed.
